The 4 Best Grab Bars of 2026 | Reviews by Wirecutter

# The Best Grab Bars

Updated August 25, 2026

Connie Park/NYT Wirecutter

By Anna Wenner

Using a grab bar is one of the best ways to prevent slips and falls in your home. But it can be a challenge to find one that works for your space and doesn’t look like it’s straight out of a hospital.

After testing 11 models, we recommend two straight grab bars: the sturdy, ADA-compliant Moen Home Care Stainless Concealed Screw Grab Bar and the narrower Zuext 16-Inch Anti Slip Stainless Steel Shower Grab Bar (the latter of which is better for smaller hands and slip resistance).

For a stylish, smaller grab bar, we prefer either the Moen Brushed Nickel 8″ Grab Bar With Toilet Paper Holder LR2352DBN or the Grabcessories 2-in-1 Tub and Shower Grab Ring 61029.

# What we looked for

- Safety

We sought grab bars with high-quality installation hardware, a weight capacity of at least 250 pounds, and solid construction.

Metal grab bars are more than just functional additions to a home—they are thoughtful investments in safety, comfort, and peace of mind for people of all ages and abilities. Whether you’re updating a bathroom for an aging parent, making a guest suite more accessible, or simply planning for the future, these supportive fixtures blend seamlessly into a wide range of interior styles. The enduring strength of metal brings confidence to daily routines, especially in spaces where moisture and slick surfaces are common, such as showers, bathtubs, and near toilets. In the warmth of late summer, when families gather and homes fill with guests, the reassurance of a well-placed grab bar can make everyone feel welcome and cared for. These fixtures are often chosen not only for their durability but also for their ability to complement both classic and modern décor, with finishes ranging from polished chrome to understated matte black. The right grab bar can be a subtle design element that quietly enhances the safety and accessibility of your space, making it easier for everyone to move with independence and ease. Choosing the perfect metal grab bar involves a blend of practical considerations and personal touches. Many people select grab bars for loved ones recovering from surgery, for children learning independence, or for friends who may need a little extra support during visits. They can even make thoughtful, meaningful gifts for anyone setting up a first home or planning a renovation with future needs in mind. When exploring your options, consider the placement and mounting style that best suits your space—wall-mounted bars offer sturdy support, while fold-down models provide flexibility in smaller bathrooms.
